cancellation_summary: Cancellations or changes must be made at least 48 hours before the departure time for a full refund
meeting_point: Pickup from select Waikiki hotels included, or Kewalo Basin Harbor Pier D, Gate 111, 1125 Ala Moana Blvd B1
location_address: 1125 Ala Moana Blvd B1 Honolulu, HI 96814
accessibility: Stroller and wheelchair access is not available
description:
Join us on a whale-watching adventure along Oahu's stunning Gold Coast, where you can witness humpback whales and other marine life in their natural habitat. The experience includes a Hawaiian cultural ceremony, live commentary from a naturalist, and the opportunity to hear whale songs with a hydrophone. Relax on our double-decker boat and enjoy the scenic ocean views.

[Disclaimer]
We warmly welcome infants (0–2 years) on our tours! For their safety, strollers and wheelchairs are not permitted on our trolleys and boats, and infants cannot occupy seats, they should be held by a caregiver throughout the tour.

Depending on weather and ocean conditions, boats may experience waves and rocking. Please note that there are no facilities for infants on board, and the crew and captain are not responsible for childcare.
what_is_included:
- Round-trip transportation from Waikiki to Harbor
- Local snacks and drinks (Poi Mochi Donut in the morning, Local Snacks in the afternoon)
- Complimentary Soft Drinks
- Hawaiian ceremony and chant "E Ho Mai"
- Whale commentary by a naturalist
- Use of a hydrophone to hear whale songs
- Hula performance by the crew
- Infants (0–2 years) ride free
what_is_not_included:
- Additional beverages ($6 beer, seltzer; $12 liquor/cocktails)
- Meals accommodating allergies (guests are advised to bring their own food)
itinerary:
- Stop 1: Sail along Oahu's Gold Coast in search of humpback whales
- Stop 2: Hear whale songs using a hydrophone
- Stop 3: Enjoy cultural experiences, including a Hawaiian ceremony and hula performance
highlights:
- Witness humpback whales up close
- Listen to whale songs through a hydrophone
- Experience a traditional ceremony 'E Ho Mai' chant
- Live hula performance by the crew
- Scenic views of Oahu's coastline
check_in_details:
Shuttle service is available from Waikiki. If you are meeting us directly, please arrive 30 minutes before the tour start time at Kewalo Harbor, Pier D, Gate 111.
Public transportation or rideshare services are recommended due to limited parking.
what_to_bring:
- Sunscreen, sunglasses, and hat
- Light jacket for the cool ocean breeze
- Camera/smartphone
- Easily removable shoes or sandals (shoes will be removed on board)
- Motion sickness medicine (if needed)
special_requirements:
- Shoes are not allowed on the boat for safety. Storage is provided onboard. Clean reef shoes and grip socks are permitted.
- No outside alcoholic beverages allowed
- Limit belongings to one bag per group due to limited space
- Meals do not accommodate allergies; prepare your own food if necessary
- For your security, at check-in you are required to present the credit card that was used to pay for your booking along with matching valid photo identification. The name listed on your credit card must be identical to the contact name listed on your booking.
extras:
**Whale-Sighting Guarantee Policy**
- The Whale Guarantee allows free rebooking only; no refunds are given if no whales are sighted.
- The captain will only designate a tour as a "no-whale-sighting tour" if no guests on the tour spot a whale. If even one guest sees a whale, the tour will not qualify as a "no-whale-sighting tour."
- If the captain determines that no whale was sighted, you may rebook the “Whales and You” tour for free until a whale is seen.
- Free rebooking is only valid for tours with open seats, and specific dates or times cannot be guaranteed.
- Guests who cannot join another tour during their stay may redeem the Whale Guarantee at any time within three years of the original tour date.
- Free rebooking applies only to the original guest(s) and cannot be transferred.
faqs:
- **What should I bring?** Sunscreen, sunglasses, hat, a light jacket, and your camera are recommended. If you are prone to seasickness, take motion sickness medicine before the tour.

- **Are whale sightings guaranteed?** While whale sightings are not guaranteed, this tour offers a high chance of seeing whales during their migration season.

- **Can I bring a stroller or wheelchair on the trolley or boat?**
For safety reasons, strollers and wheelchairs are not allowed on our trolleys and boats.

- **Can infants (0–2 years) occupy a seat?**
Infants cannot occupy seats and must be held by a caregiver throughout the tour.

- **Are there facilities for infants on the boat?**
No, there are no facilities for infants on board.
